caveats: Known limitation (NEXT.md): per-site velocity measured on small precedent pools does not transfer cleanly to 100+ site programmes.
The eligibility read is a language model reading text. On historical (`asOf`) runs the registry evidence is date-filtered, but the model's own knowledge boundary cannot be sealed.

The forecaster also searched for the cheapest rescue: Feasible but slow at 22 months; no biomarker relaxation reaches 18 months (all-comers gives 19). Comfortable enrolment would need ~85 sites at the current marker. (reaches "none", 19 months). That is a modelled what-if, not a plan.

keyNumbers.basis: Score is a straight-line mapping of months: 1.0 at or under 18 months, 0 at or beyond 48 months. Here 22 months.

keyNumbers.basis: Site count basis: precedent (75th percentile of site counts among precedents that enrolled at least half the required N, clamped to 40–250).
keyNumbers.label: Sites assumed open

keyNumbers.basis: Across EoE trials, the biomarker-positive population is further reduced by exclusions for alternative causes of eosinophilia, structural esophageal disease, recent steroid/biologic use, and symptom/dysphagia entry thresholds (NCT03029091, NCT02227836, NCT03191864, NCT04322708). These stacked but only partially overlapping criteria typically remove roughly half of biomarker-positive patients. Drivers named from the criteria text: exclusion of other causes of esophageal eosinophilia (hypereosinophilic syndrome, Churg-Strauss/EGPA, parasitic infection, celiac, Crohn's, achalasia); esophageal stricture precluding endoscope passage or requiring dilation; washout/stability requirements for PPIs, topical/systemic corticosteroids, and prior biologics (esp. exclusion of prior anti-IL-4R/dupilumab exposure); requirement for symptomatic dysphagia frequency/severity thresholds; exclusion for concomitant EG/EoD or eosinophilic colitis and other GI comorbidities; contraception/pregnancy and general safety/lab exclusions. Cited: NCT03029091, NCT02227836, NCT03191864, NCT04322708.
keyNumbers.label: Eligibility pass rate

keyNumbers.basis: 1 / (biomarker prevalence x eligibility pass rate). This is where low prevalence lands as cost once the model's screening floor stops it landing as time.
keyNumbers.label: Patients screened per enrollee

keyNumbers.basis: Interventional trials recruiting the same population, scaled from the sampled page to the registry total. Each takes an 8% share of the patient pool in the model.
keyNumbers.label: Competing trials

caveats: Two wirings that look obvious are wrong and are refused on purpose (documented in economics-bridge.ts): recruitability score is NOT a probability of approval, and stage durations do NOT move the launch year.
The delay is rounded to whole years because that is the granularity the economics engine applies to a sampled delay.

This adapter produces an INSTRUCTION, not an applied change: the economics run below is the baseline, and the delay is priced by multiplying the engine's own per-year delay cost. Nobody has re-run the engine with the delay applied.

ROUNDED AWAY: the forecast slips 4 months past the planned window, but whole-year rounding books that as 0 delay years and therefore 0 dollars of delay cost. The slip is real; the price of it is not being charged.
